skill.text:
Enhance Passive Skills: 
Lv Bu has a {{10%}} HP lock, preventing her HP from falling below {{10%}} of Max HP (after deploying or reviving, each enemy adds a {{5%}} HP lock to Lv Bu). 
While attacked, Lv Bu gains War God Points (WGP) equal to DMG received (including excess). At the start of the enemy's round, if WGP exceed {{75%}} of her Max HP, all WGP are removed, and she receives {{1}} [War Injury] for removed WGP equal to {{75%}} of Max HP.

skill.name: Eternity Epic
skill.text:
When possessing [Fury Soul] and {{1000}} Fury, ULT evolves into a Mega ULT.
[Fury Soul]: For every {{2000}} Fury gained (ignoring the Fury cap), activate [Fury Soul].
Consumes [Fury Soul] and {{1000}} Fury to unleash Mega ULT.
Mega ULT:
Deals {{700%}} DMG to a single enemy, Prioritizes attacking frontline enemy heroes without [Deep Wound]. Inflicts [Deep Wound] on the main target.
All DMG from the Mega ULT ignores <{{Target's [Deterrence] stacks × 10%}}> of the target's DMG Reduce.
When cast, grants [Perseus's Shield] to {{1}} hero with the lowest HP (prioritizes teammates).
[Perseus's Shield]: Reduces the next {{2}} instances of DMG taken by {{99%}} on the target. Lasts the entire battle. Cannot be dispelled.
If this attack is a Counterattack:
Consumes all stacks of [Perseus's Sword]. Deals additional DMG equal to {{25%}} of max HP (up to {{25%}} of Perseus's max HP) to {{<Consumed [Perseus's Sword] stacks>}} enemies excluding the main target. This DMG does not restore Fury.
For each stack of [Perseus's Sword] consumed, increases Perseus's DMG UP by {{5%}} for {{2}} rounds (each stack's duration is tracked separately).
If the number of [Perseus's Sword] stacks consumed exceeds the number of enemies (excluding main target), grants {{50}} stacks of [Perseus's Strength] per excess stack. If this causes [Perseus's Strength] to exceed {{100}} stacks, consumes {{100}} stacks to gain {{1}} [Perseus's Sword] stack (repeatable until [Perseus's Strength] falls below {{100}}). [Perseus's Strength] gained this way cannot trigger other [Perseus's Strength]-related effects.
If this attack is not a Counterattack:
Gains Perseus {{3}} stacks of [Perseus's Sword].
If this exceeds the max stacks ({{5}}), deals additional DMG equal to {{5%}} of target's max HP (up to {{15%}} of Perseus's max HP) per excess stack.
Enhances Passive Skill:
Upon entering battle or being revived, gains {{90}} stacks of [Perseus's Strength] and {{1}} stack of [Perseus's Sword].
Upon revival, apply {{1}} stack of [Deep Wound] to all enemies and gain {{1}} stack of [Perseus' Sword], while removing all [Black Blood] effects from self; increase own DMG Reduce by <{{20% + 5% x Number of enemy heroes on the field}}>, lasting for {{2}} rounds. Each stack's duration is calculated independently.
